svg.title: Hybrid Billing high-level logical architecture
svg.desc: HB-19 architecture review draft. Logical modules and controlled flows; no deployment or technology selection. SaaS overlay is unmerged PR14.
svg.text: High-level logical architecture / Responsibilities before technology and server configuration
SaaS subscription & service policy | PR14 proposal
Catalog / plan / seat / meter revisions feed ordinary pricing and approval.
Desired service grants -> scoped delivery -> acknowledged actual grants.
Payment status does not directly grant access; grace and suspension need policy.
Approval, Claim and outbox coordinate in local authority
Eligible period basis -> fixed batch -> own approval
Separate ERP purpose; do not wait for invoice cadence
No duplicate recognition when later invoicing
Unknown is not success or failure; no blind retry
Only eligible manifests feed final billing
Result evidence updates owned business state.
Transport success is not settlement or ERP posting.
Authoritative state + permitted detail/projections -> current scoped reads
Authorization before aggregation and before download/output release
Read through the same permission boundary; retain evidence lineage
Proposals return to ordinary commands; no direct ledger write/approval
Blue: billing flow Green: recognition Amber: external confirmation Gray: scoped control/read Purple: proposed SaaS input
Logical modules, not one service per box. Storage access is summarized. No technology, node count or runtime capability is certified.
